pr_title: catch JS exceptions when using InvokeAsync and throw them in .NET
pr_body:
# catch JS exceptions when using InvokeAsync and throw them in .NET

Exceptions in `createJSCallResult` and `stringifyArgs` were only thrown in JS before and .NET never received them.

Examples of exceptions which are now reaching .NET:
- https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/371bf375f5bf6e48ab6b33e24ad0c73a940b4ae4/src/JSInterop/Microsoft.JSInterop.JS/src/src/Microsoft.JSInterop.ts#L591
- https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/371bf375f5bf6e48ab6b33e24ad0c73a940b4ae4/src/JSInterop/Microsoft.JSInterop.JS/src/src/Microsoft.JSInterop.ts#L167-L188
- https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/371bf375f5bf6e48ab6b33e24ad0c73a940b4ae4/src/JSInterop/Microsoft.JSInterop.JS/src/src/Microsoft.JSInterop.ts#L148

Fixes #40272 (references the last exception from the list above)
Fixes #41934 (exception in `stringifyArgs`)
pr_comments:
Thanks for your PR, @campersau.
@MackinnonBuck can you please review this? Thanks!

issue_context.title: JSRuntime "open" with "_blank" throws TaskCanceledException 60 seconds later
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

Clicking a button that calls the following results in a TaskCanceledException about 60 seconds later.

```c#
await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<string>("open", $"https://www.microsoft.com", "_blank");
```

### Expected Behavior

No TaskCanceledException is thrown

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Run the project (tested with `dotnet run` and VS Mac (ARM)) in Safari or Firefox on macOS
2. Click a button that calls the following: `await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<string>("open", $"https://www.microsoft.com", "_blank");` via an `@onclick` method
3. Notice in the exception in the browser console (and in VS Mac (ARM) as well if started there)

### Exceptions (if any)

browser console error:
> Error: System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
   at Microsoft.JSInterop.JSRuntime.InvokeAsync[TValue](Int64 targetInstanceId, String identifier, Object[] args)

VS Mac (ARM) error:
> Exception thrown: 'System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException' in System.Private.CoreLib.dll

### .NET Version

6.0.300

That usually means there is an error somewhere in the Browser, usually caused by trying to serialize back a non serializable result and that the response wasn't correctly sent back. Are there any errors in the browser console?
